metadata.description: cm8908's personal aggregator marketplace. One repo to add on any machine: custom Claude Code plugins/skills plus curated third-party skills.

plugins.name: llm-wiki-meta
plugins.description: Meta-level skills for managing a multi-category LLM wiki (Karpathy pattern): list/current/attach/detach/create/remove sub-wikis, plus attached-only wiki-ingest/query/lint dispatchers under a single top-level llm-wiki/ root.

plugins.name: cm8908-custom
plugins.description: Catch-all home for cm8908's standalone custom skills. Drop a skills/<name>/SKILL.md folder and it is auto-discovered — no manifest edit needed.

plugins.name: cm8908-thirdparty
plugins.description: Vendored third-party skills that upstream does not ship as plugins. Each skill records its origin and pinned commit in SOURCE.md.

plugins.name: akb-wiki
plugins.description: [third-party: dnotitia/akb] LLM-wiki layer for AKB vaults — /akb-ingest (file/URL/GitHub PR·release·commit/Confluence/Jira) and /akb-query (grounded, cited, read-only). Carries the shared `akb` MCP server the other akb-* plugins reuse — install this first. Needs AKB_MCP_URL + AKB_PAT.

plugins.name: akb-sessions
plugins.description: [third-party: dnotitia/akb] Capture a coding session into an AKB vault as structured notes — a session report plus parallel-drafted TIL/task/idea/decision sub-notes. Reuses akb-wiki's `akb` MCP server.

plugins.name: akb-claude-code
plugins.description: [third-party: dnotitia/akb] Claude Code lifecycle bridge (hooks only, no slash command): anchors each session to your AKB memory vault, injects prefs + recent learnings at session start, snapshots before context compaction, writes a recap at end.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: [third-party: mattpocock/skills] Matt Pocock's agent skills for real engineering — grilling, spec/ticket flows (to-spec/to-tickets/triage), TDD, code review, domain modelling, codebase design, implement, prototype, research, handoff, and more (~22 skills). MIT.
